predictions.source_summary: Environment variables from the PHP-FPM parent process (system environment, buildpack runtime). The comment indicates variables like LD_LIBRARY_PATH are passed. The #{PHP_ENV} template is expanded at compile time to produce env[<var>] = $<var> entries.
predictions.sink_summary: PHP application runtime environment accessible via getenv(), $_ENV, $_SERVER superglobals. Sensitive variables could be exposed to PHP code execution.
predictions.guard_summary: Default PHP-FPM behavior (clean env) is disabled. No explicit validation or filtering of which environment variables are exposed. The #{PHP_ENV} template suggests some variable selection occurs at build time but unclear if this provides security filtering.
predictions.risk_pattern: PHP-FPM configuration disables environment clearing, exposing parent process environment variables (potentially containing secrets, API keys, database credentials) to PHP applications.
predictions.context_summary: Configuration file comment indicates purpose: 'Pass environment variables like LD_LIBRARY_PATH. All $VARIABLEs are taken from the current environment.' Template #{PHP_ENV} is expanded at compile time to produce environment variable mappings.
unresolved_facts: Which specific environment variables are exposed via #{PHP_ENV} expansion
Whether the buildpack filters sensitive variables during PHP_ENV expansion
Whether PHP applications in this deployment actually access environment variables containing secrets
Whether other PHP-FPM pools or configurations have different clear_env settings
